title: The Role of Insulin Resistance in Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease
venue: The Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism
abstract: Insulin resistance is a major feature of NAFLD that, in some patients, can progress to steatohepatitis. Treatments aimed at reducing insulin resistance have had some success, but larger placebo-controlled studies are needed to fully establish the efficacy of these interventions and possibly others in reducing the deleterious effects of fat accumulation in the liver.
